description:
Three claim commands declare a storage type parameter they never use, which forces turbofish calls, and an uncalled lease check sits beside them.

## Background

`execute_claim_renew<S>` (`crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:421`), `execute_claim_status<S>` (`:469`) and `execute_claim_force_evict<S>` (`:618`) declare `<S: IssueStore>` but take no `S` argument. Their only callers use turbofish (`main.rs:8275-8278,8350-8353,8516-8519`). `execute_claim_release_by_issue<S>` (`:334`) takes `storage: &S` and stays. `check_issue_lease` (`claim.rs:542-605`, with its doc) has no caller.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The renew, status and force-evict claim commands carry no storage type parameter, and their callers use no turbofish.
- [hard] REQ-02: `check_issue_lease` no longer exists.
title: Drop the unused storage type parameter from claim commands
